customer: hey so im moving for a new job and want to sell my minivan to northwind before i go, but i cant find the title anywhere?? do i need to get a paper copy first or what
agent: No worries, Dunmore uses electronic titles, so for a sale to Northwind you usually don't need the printout because we transfer the electronic title at the appointment. If you'd still like a printed duplicate, you can request it online from the Dunmore motor vehicle agency, and it arrives in 5 to 7 business days. You can find more in our article "Getting a duplicate title in Dunmore."
